proposed_move.name: Exhaustive staged classifier-copy substitution for C2 independence
proposed_move.owner: L1 integration; this seat proposes only
steps: After git archive staging, enumerate regular non-symlink files under tools/ and .ufo/waves/** whose sha256 is in the known classifier set {36fdc459..., 46c82902..., a57d4fe9...} or whose basename is tool-before.py or mado-tripwire.py and whose hash matches an explicit pin; record path, sha256, bytes, mode.

Apply each state (base, changed, absent, read_fifo, execution_marker) to every discovered copy, not only tools/mado-tripwire.py. For base write baseline bytes to all copies; changed write candidate bytes to all; absent unlink all; read_fifo mkfifo all; execution_marker write marker to all.

Record classifier_copy_inventory, substituted_paths, unsubstituted_candidates and per-copy pre/post hashes in the receipt; replace the bare state label 'absent' with 'known_classifier_copies_absent' or add state_scope so the receipt cannot be read as 'no classifier bytes exist'.

Extend positive_controls to every copy: for each path run the hashing control on base vs changed (require different signatures), require FIFO timeout, and require marker execution (exit 83 plus marker). Set sensitive = all copies sensitive.
Extend intact to require every substituted copy to be at the state's expected hash/absence/FIFO after each run, and to require the gate and fixture tree unchanged as today.
Add a limitation line: only enumerated copies are controlled; absolute-path reads outside the staged tree, stat-only reads, nonblocking opens, and unenumerated copies are not detected.
proposed_move.why_it_improves: The current receipt can report identical_outputs=true and pass_intervention=true while two in-tree C1 sources are invariant, so the intervention does not demonstrate the declared negative for those paths. The extension covers every known copy and makes the receipt's scope explicit without changing any fixture, expected value, tool, or C1 byte.
proposed_move.no_harm_expectation: The delivered tools/mado-evidence-audit.py does not read any copy, and its --selftest inventory contains no tools/ path, so extending substitution should leave the delivered gate's outputs and expected exits unchanged.

risks: Discovery can miss a future copy with a different size/hash; mitigate with explicit --classifier-copies pins and record unmatched tool-before/mado-tripwire-named files as unsubstituted_candidates.
Substituting .ufo/waves/round-21/evidence/tool-before.py changes staged provenance bytes; this must happen only in the temp stage, with original hashes recorded, never in the checkout.

A gate that legitimately reads a historical copy would now produce non-identical output; that is the finding the intervention exists to surface, not a harness failure, but L1 should inspect it rather than treating pass=false as automatically a candidate defect.
Multiple marker copies write the same marker path; make the marker write idempotent and clean between states; do not let marker_present leak across states.
Do not follow symlinks or hardlinks when substituting copies; use lstat and reject nonregular entries, matching the existing regular() discipline.
Keep the existing one-child, 384 MiB address-space, 15 s limits; the added hashing is a handful of files, not a corpus scan.
verification_plan: Static: assert every discovered copy is mutated in every state; assert receipt classifiers copy inventory and substituted_paths are present and complete; assert no write path remains outside the loop.

L1 run after the wave: independence.py --revision 71228fd582d6d9338d7916cc64e69bd4c2e928b5 --fixtures .ufo/waves/round-22/audit/fixtures; expect identical_outputs=true, selftest_ok=true, expected_exits_match=true, fixtures_and_gate_unchanged=true, positive_control_sensitive=true, pass_intervention=true, with all three copies enumerated.

Negative controls in L1's private sandbox: a coupled probe that reads .ufo/waves/round-22/evidence/tool-before.py and changes its output must yield identical_outputs=false under the extended harness while the current harness passes it; the same for .ufo/waves/round-21/evidence/tool-before.py and for tools/mado-tripwire.py. Do not call any proposed fault killed before L1 runs it.
